Best money market accounts. # Just Play and Hasbro Reimagine EASY-BAKE and PLAYSKOOL Toys for a New Generation. *The Iconic Toy Brands Debut New Products Exclusively at Walmart, Available Now*. 4, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- Just Play, in collaboration with Hasbro, a leading games, IP and toy company, is relaunching two of the most iconic toy brands of all time: **EASY-BAKE and PLAYSKOOL.** Available now exclusively at Walmart, these refreshed product lines bring modern updates to brands that have inspired creativity and play for decades. The new Easy-Bake Ultimate Oven and Freezy-Bake Ice Cream Maker inspire a new generation to explore food play and are available now, exclusively at Walmart. EASY-BAKE has been encouraging aspiring young bakers and chefs to explore food play for over 60 years with toys that let them create tasty treats without the use of a real oven. "EASY-BAKE and PLAYSKOOL are brands that families have loved for generations," said Sunny Lauridsen, Senior Vice President of Brand Strategy and Marketing at Just Play. "Few brands hold the iconic status and enduring appeal of EASY-BAKE and PLAYSKOOL," said Bradley Bowman, Senior Director of Global Licensed Toy and Games at Hasbro. From the nostalgic charm of the Ultimate Oven and the cool creativity of Freezy-Bake, to the modern, developmentally rich PLAYSKOOL line that supports preschoolers' cognitive, social, and emotional growth, these products deliver hands-on, engaging experiences for kids and parents alike.". Hasbro is a leading games, IP and toy company whose mission is to create joy and community through the magic of play. For more than a decade, Hasbro has been consistently recognized for its corporate citizenship, including being named one of the 100 Best Corporate Citizens by 3BL Media, a 2025 JUST Capital Industry Leader, one of the 50 Most Community-Minded Companies in the U.S. by the Civic 50, and a Brand that Matters by Fast Company. For more information, visit https://corporate.hasbro.com or @Hasbro on LinkedIn. Hasbro (HAS) just made headlines with a move bound to get both investors and toy aficionados talking. The company, teaming up with Just Play, has relaunched its legendary EASY-BAKE and PLAYSKOOL brands, offering updated classics and all-new twists crafted for modern families. With exclusive rights granted to Walmart, Hasbro is betting big on nostalgia-driven demand and accessible innovation to re-energize some of its most recognized products. For those weighing Hasbro's shares, this is not just another product refresh; it is a calculated play at capturing market share where heritage and fresh design meet. The timing of this relaunch lines up with a stretch of growing momentum for Hasbro's stock. By reinvigorating iconic lines, Hasbro is clearly leaning into strategies that have the potential for both immediate impact and long-term brand value. But with this surge in performance, the real question for investors remains: Is Hasbro still undervalued given these growth moves, or has the market already factored this in?
